doc:
**R(3,3) = 6.** Colour every edge of the complete graph on six vertices with one of two
colours: some triangle always has all three edges the same colour. Five vertices are not enough:
the pentagon colouring of the complete graph on five vertices has no such triangle.
pretty: And ((c : @Sym2 (Fin 6) → Bool) → MonoTriangle 6 c) (@Exists (@Sym2 (Fin 5) → Bool) fun c => Not (MonoTriangle 5 c))
title: Ramsey Three Three:- R(3,3)
